name: good_morning_recruiting
description: Recruiting health briefing for Talent Acquisition (TA) leaders. Runs eight TA metrics in one briefing, or any one of them on demand: hiring manager sentiment, sourced percentage, req load by recruiter, stale candidates, competitor hires, competitor hiring intelligence (web), stale job openings, and recent offer declines. Supports PDF report generation. Use for hiring manager sentiment, recruiter sourced percentage, competitor hiring intelligence, recruiter performance, TA OKR metrics, recruiting health check. Triggers: TA metrics, recruiting metrics, GM TA report, hiring manager sentiment, sourced percentage, req load, stale candidates, competitor hires, stale openings, offer declines, recruiting briefing. Do NOT use for: a single candidate's debrief (use interview_debrief), workforce headcount (use headcount_insights), or a leader's weekly hiring PDF (use hiring_brief).
